title: Shared identifiers, revisions and business keys
description: ENG-01 new contract. Source: SA v1.0 08.1/08.3 (tenant-scoped primary keys, expected_revision, Idempotency-Key) 與 SD work-execution-contract.md §2/§6。不還原未取得的 01_schema.sql／資料字典.md，本檔是本次新增的機器可讀版本。

Uuid.description: Application-generated UUID per SA 08.1; external numeric IDs are never used as this platform's primary key.

TenantScopedRef.description: (tenant_id, id) composite reference per SA 08.1 and SD §2: every business parent/child/actor/order/policy/approval/asset/connector foreign key carries tenant_id.

Revision.description: Monotonically increasing per-row revision used as expected_revision / If-Match target (SA BR-09; SD §6.1).

OwnerRevision.description: Atomically incremented when a human takes over reply ownership from an AI turn (SA 04.4 真人接手; SD work-execution-contract.md §6.3). 0 means never handed off.

FenceToken.description: Monotonically increasing lease fence (SA §03 工作 lease 與副作用; SD §6.3). Must never be reused once superseded.

BusinessOperationKey.description: Stable business key derived from the business source, e.g. booking:create:<quote_id>, refund:<remedy_action_id> (SD work-execution-contract.md §2). Never regenerated as a random UUID on retry; UNIQUE(tenant_id, operation, business_key) at the persistence layer is ENG-02 scope.

IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied API idempotency key. Scope for deduplication is (tenant_id, actor_id, operation, idempotency_key) per SD §6.1; distinct from BusinessOperationKey, which survives a changed idempotency key.

Timestamp.description: UTC timestamptz per SA 08.1. Service-local wall-clock meaning (e.g. check-in date) is carried separately with an IANA timezone, not derived from this field.

IanaTimeZone.description: IANA timezone identifier, e.g. Asia/Taipei, stored alongside any service-local date per SA 08.1.

SchemaVersion.description: Per-contract payload schema version, e.g. "1.0" (SA 08.8 event envelope `schema_version`). A minor bump adds optional fields; a major bump is required for any change to an existing field's meaning or type.

ActorRef.description: Who is acting: AI session, employee, customer or channel principal. Scope and tenant are always derived from a verified credential (SA FR-01, FR-29), never taken from caller-supplied payload.

on_behalf_of_case_owner_revision.description: Case owner_revision the actor believed was current when it acted; used to detect stale AI turns after a human handoff (SA 04.4).
